units.title: Tool Wear Prediction Engine
gaps: No single unified 4-mechanism (adhesive+abrasive+diffusive+chemical) wear-rate composition action; mechanisms scattered across 3+ engines
No measured JM Die wear-vs-predicted dataset; only synthetic Taylor-generated corpus (state/shared/corpus/cam-tool-life-tuples.jsonl) - circular for validation
Spec's <8% error criterion is data-blocked, not code-blocked
units.nextAction: Ship a thin unified_wear_rate composition action summing the four existing mechanism engines under shared force/temperature state with per-mechanism attribution + RSS uncertainty, wired to prism_calc; open a separate data-capture unit for real JM wear measurements and report the validation criterion as blocked (R12) until it exists.

units.title: Tool Reconditioning Quality and Economics
gaps: Reconditioning QUALITY scoring model (edge prep, coating integrity, geometry restoration) genuinely missing
Post-regrind performance derate is a hardcoded 0.7 factor (InventoryAwareToolSelectorEngine.ts:237), not physics-based Taylor-curve shift
No JM Die reconditioning-outcome records in-repo (jm-tool-purchases.json is purchases only)
No scheduler/quoting consumer of economicLife for recondition-vs-replace at job planning
units.nextAction: Build a compact ReconditioningQualityEngine whose Taylor-shift output feeds the already-wired economicLife/costPerCutMinute surfaces, replacing the hardcoded 0.7 derate; flag JM reconditioning-record validation as data-blocked and queue a capture unit.

units.title: Built-Up Edge Mitigation and Tool Breakage Recovery
gaps: No multi-lever BUE mitigation recommender (onset engine outputs only raise-Vc; coating/coolant/rake levers exist but uncomposed)
No physics-based breakage root-cause analyzer inverting the four damage models from an observed break; recovery is per-controller procedural text only
No structured JM Die breakage-incident dataset for validation
units.nextAction: Add bue_mitigation_recommend (compose BUE bands with CoatingSelection + CAMCoolantStrategy into ranked levers) and breakage_root_cause (invert ToolBreakagePredictionEngine damage models, tail into getRecoveryProcedure), wire both to prism_safety; do NOT create the two new engines the spec names - they would duplicate existing assets.

units.title: Tool Life Extension Strategies
gaps: No integrated strategy recommender composing the 5 existing levers with predicted life gain and ROI ranking
Edge-prep (hone/K-factor) lever not confirmed modeled anywhere (PARTIAL-UNVERIFIED hits only)
Before/after extended-life validation corpus is synthetic (Taylor-generated) - circular; 10+ real jobs criterion data-blocked
Recommender must import Taylor/kc constants from physics/constants.ts, not re-inline per-engine tables
units.nextAction: Build ONE thin ToolLifeExtensionRecommenderEngine fanning out to the five verified lever engines, quantifying each lever's life multiplier through the existing Taylor/wear stack and pricing via ToolLifeEconomicReplacementFormula, returning ranked levers with uncertainty; wire to prism_calc + businessDispatcher in the same commit after duplicationGuard check.
